fields.title: Welcome to Night City Card Errata

fields.bodyMarkdown:
### Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting (Beta Iconic Rare)

The Beta Iconic Rare variant of *Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting* was erroneously printed with the Eurodollar “Sell” tag. Consistent with all other versions of *Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting*, this card cannot be sold for an Eddie during gameplay.

![Johnny Iconic Errata](//images.ctfassets.net/udihssg1zwbu/2IJe3zHqouiYKuEyh7HFZC/cd31efcae8ee090aac5f1627ad1e9bb0/Jonny_Fixed_Errata_Full.png)

### Kiroshi Optics

The reminder text about how equipping Gear works on *Kiroshi Optics* is inconsistent with other Gear cards in *Cyberpunk TCG*. The reminder text has been updated to “Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend”, in line with all other Gear cards.

![Kiroshi Optics Errata](//images.ctfassets.net/udihssg1zwbu/5Ypa8AjTOsJgrGat0gW9G9/57725b075aa355a80c7701824ba5a847/Kiroshi_Fixed_Errata_Full.png)

### Nocturne OP55N1

*Nocturne OP55N1* was printed with an incorrect artist credit. The card text has been revised to properly credit the creator of this art piece — Daniel Valaisis.

![Nocturne Errata](//images.ctfassets.net/udihssg1zwbu/Wyzig3Hhgp8YWrIH1HMpR/1e9b9d83e92a585712bb0ac7fc3a63f3/Nocturne_Fixed_Errata.png)

### Judy Álvarez: Nothing to Doubt

The printed artist credit on *Judy Álvarez: Nothing to Doubt* contains a typo. It has been corrected to properly credit the artist — Ilya Kuvshinov.

![Judy Unit Errata](//images.ctfassets.net/udihssg1zwbu/60Tho0nZ6FF2u6OEZynVc6/ea73517d36cd85c367827ae2499396f5/Judy_Fixed_Errata_Full.png)

fields.introMarkdown:
After a card has been created, it’s sometimes necessary to make small tweaks to its printed text. On this page you’ll find a record of all the changes and clarifications we’ve made to card text to date.

During gameplay, every card on this page should be played as if it bears the updated text and characteristics associated with it. The updated text shown here supersedes all printed text at all levels of play.
